# Radoslav Radev Recommends Limiting Maximum-Effort Planche Training to Two Sessions Per Week

Radoslav Radev recommends limiting maximum-effort planche training to two sessions per week, with the remaining sessions focused on technique, quality, or lower-intensity work. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 01:43]

## Details

- Training to failure every workout tires the nervous system and leads to decreasing progress over consecutive sessions. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 00:20]
- Have one workout pushing maximum, and the next workout focus on quality, fix technique, or another skill to give the nervous system enough rest. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 01:15]
- On days you do not feel strong, fix technique, use a lower progression, use a resistance band, or do a deload workout rather than pushing planche attempts to maximum. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 02:01]
- If you train four or five times per week, only two sessions should be maximum effort. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 01:43]

## Evidence

- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 00:20 (Radoslav Radev): "let's say you train four times per week you're training planche and foot [front] lever and every single one of these days you're pushing yourself to the limit"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 01:15 (Radoslav Radev): "the truth is you have to have one workout pushing yourself maximum, the other workout to focus on the quality, fix your technique or some other skill, for example, or something else to give your nervous system enough rest for the next workout"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 01:43 (Radoslav Radev): "So if you train four or five times per week, two times per week, maximum you have to push yourself to the limit"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 01:47 (Radoslav Radev): "my advice for you is to do it on the days that you're feeling recovered you're feeling strong"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 02:01 (Radoslav Radev): "on the days that you're not feeling good you can fix something in your technique some some mistake that you're doing or you can just go on a little bit lower progression or you can put resistance band or just like deload workout for the activation to try something new"
